create_html_formatter: create an HTMLFormatter to render a Polars DataFrame as an HTML table with configurable max columns and rows
create_notebook_formatter: create a NotebookFormatter to render a Polars DataFrame as styled HTML for Jupyter Notebook display
create_tag_context_manager: create a Tag context manager to build HTML elements with opening and closing tags and optional attributes
create_replace_consecutive_spaces: create a replace_consecutive_spaces function to convert consecutive spaces to HTML non-breaking space entities
test_html_formatter_render: test the HTMLFormatter render method to produce a list of HTML table element strings for a DataFrame
